settingsCenter.title: Settings
settingsCenter.description: Manage how POP looks, communicates, and protects your account.
settingsCenter.loadFailed: Settings could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
settingsCenter.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Verify again or retry.
settingsCenter.appearanceShort: Theme, language, font, and readable system scaling.
settingsCenter.notificationsShort: Choose the categories of POP messages you want.
settingsCenter.privacyShort: Review profile visibility and privacy controls.
settingsCenter.permissionsShort: See the real permission state reported by this device.
settingsCenter.securityShort: Passkeys, recovery, devices, and active sessions.
settingsCenter.accountShort: Phone number, account lifecycle, and support.
settingsCenter.legalShort: Read the current Terms and Privacy Policy.
settingsCenter.appearanceHelp: Choose System, Light, or Dark. Your selection applies immediately and is saved for your other POP clients.
settingsCenter.notificationsHelp: These preferences are separate from your operating system notification permission.
settingsCenter.privacyHelp: Privacy settings never turn on Nearby or request contacts automatically.
settingsCenter.permissionsHelp: POP shows the device state here but never requests a permission just because you opened Settings.
settingsCenter.securityHelp: Review real sign-in authority, recovery readiness, passkeys, devices, and sessions.
settingsCenter.devicesHelp: A device is a logical record linked to real Web or Android session authority; it is never an authentication authority itself.
settingsCenter.sessionsHelp: Sessions are derived from real Web session records and Android refresh-token families.
settingsCenter.passkeysHelp: Passkeys use your device credential manager. Phone OTP remains available as recovery.
settingsCenter.accountHelp: Sensitive account changes require a recent passkey or recovery-phone verification.
settingsCenter.helpHelp: Get help or send product feedback without sharing authentication data.
settingsCenter.legalHelp: POP always serves the current legal documents from trusted in-app routes.
settingsCenter.rootHelp: Choose a category to manage your POP preferences and security.
settingsCenter.accessibilityScale: POP respects your browser text size, display scaling, contrast, and reduced-motion settings.
settingsCenter.osPermissionHelp: This permission belongs to your browser or device. POP notification preferences do not change it.
settingsCenter.notificationDeliveryFoundation: Notification delivery categories are stored now. Delivery remains best-effort and requires a valid device push token.
settingsCenter.shareActivityIdentity: Show my identity with shared activity
settingsCenter.permissionsNoRequest: No permission is requested from this page. Change browser or operating system permissions in the device settings.
settingsCenter.onlyThisDevice: No other active items were found.
settingsCenter.confirmOthers: Sign out every other Web and Android session while keeping this session?
settingsCenter.confirmEverywhere: Sign out every Web and Android session, including this one?
settingsCenter.confirmCurrent: Sign out this current session now?
settingsCenter.othersRevoked: Other sessions were revoked. Push-token cleanup is being handled independently.
settingsCenter.confirmRemovePasskey: Remove this passkey? You will keep phone recovery when it is available.
settingsCenter.changePhoneHelp: Verify your current session, then verify the new phone number. The new number becomes authoritative only after its OTP succeeds.
settingsCenter.phoneChanged: Your authoritative recovery phone was changed.
settingsCenter.deleteAccountHelp: This creates an idempotent deletion request for review. It does not immediately hard-delete your account or products.
settingsCenter.confirmDeletion: Request account deletion? This starts the review lifecycle and does not immediately erase data.
settingsCenter.deletionRequested: Your account deletion request was recorded.
settingsCenter.confirmProductLost: Mark this product as lost? Sharing will stop until a supported recovery action is completed.
settingsCenter.productLostFailed: The product could not be marked lost.
settingsCenter.menuHelp: Security and preferences are grouped separately from social and connected-account features.

nearbyCenter.description: Discover people who explicitly chose to be visible in the same broad area. POP never shows a map, coordinates, exact distance, or last-seen time.
nearbyCenter.unavailableHelp: Nearby is safely off for this account or rollout. Nothing is shared.
nearbyCenter.communityHelp: Accept the current Community Guidelines in Friends before using Nearby.
nearbyCenter.consentHelp: Nearby uses an approximate area only while this screen is active. Your exact coordinates are not stored or shown. You can turn Nearby off at any time.
nearbyCenter.profileHelp: Nearby uses the published social profile selected in Friends. Private, paused, archived, and unpublished profiles stay hidden.
nearbyCenter.offHelp: Turn Nearby on to share a short-lived approximate-area presence and view opted-in people nearby.
nearbyCenter.resumeHelp: Your earlier presence expired or this page restarted. Resume explicitly to share a new short-lived presence.

nearbyCenter.permissionUnavailable: Location is unavailable on this browser or device.

nearbyCenter.activeHelp: Presence remains short-lived and is refreshed only while this page is visible. Leaving or hiding this page stops collection.
nearbyCenter.noResults: No one is available in this broad area right now.
